elder_dragon: a huge ancient red dragon rearing up on its hind legs, wings spread wide, neck curved forward as it breathes a roaring stream of orange fire toward the lower right. Cracked crimson scales, a pale yellow belly, long curved horns and a ragged frill. It stands on a mound of gold coins and goblets. Glowing embers drift behind its wings against a pale dusty teal sky.
weakness_curse: a lone armored knight seen from behind and slightly below, sinking to one knee, his steel sword cracking in half in his gauntlet. Thin wisps of sickly green smoke coil around his arms and drag his shoulders down. His blue tabard hangs limp. A wide pale ochre sky fills the space behind him, with green smoke curling upward.
rat_burrow: a crooked earthen mound with a dark round tunnel opening at its base, propped with broken wooden planks and a rusty iron grate. A stream of grey rats pours out of the tunnel and scatters forward across the dirt, tails whipping. Dust kicks up behind them. A soft pale lilac sky above the mound.
death_knight: a towering undead knight in black plate armor charging forward on foot, a long notched greatsword raised over one shoulder. A tattered dark-blue cape whips behind him, his helmet visor glows with two cold cyan eyes, and frost flakes trail from his armor. A ruined graveyard gate stands behind him against a dusty ochre sky.
goblin_dynamiter: a small wiry green goblin sprinting forward with a gleeful toothy grin, clutching a bundle of red dynamite sticks with a sizzling lit fuse against his chest. Big pointed ears, a dented leather cap, oversized goggles pushed up on his forehead. Bright sparks spray behind him from the fuse. A plain warm sand-colored background with a small wooden mine cart behind him.
